summary: South verge against bush on a quiet street; homes 16 m across, steep.

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush on the south side; detached homes sit 15-17 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane with a dirt and grass verge between the kerb and the bush at the north-west end, about a van wide; the first 40 m is a narrow bush lane with no room.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, local traffic only; the road is open at both ends.
drivers.convention: No parked cars seen in either image; mapped sign is No Parking Any Time, which the imagery does not contradict.

flags: Steep: about 7% fall at the best section, max 16.6% elsewhere
No Parking Any Time sign mapped on this kerb
Homes within about 25 m across the road
sun_shade: Bush canopy shades the verge from the south and west; open to morning sun from the east.

best_section.where: South edge of Francis Terrace on the dirt verge beside the bush, opposite the middle houses of the terrace
